name: p2p-docker-dev-managed-code
comment: Phase 5 combines the swarm stack (hyperswarm/hyperdht), the AVRO RPC layer (avsc + avsc-rpc git-cloned in the Dockerfile; their registry sibling deps listed here), and the storage stack (corestore/hyperdrive/b4a — first-party Pear-native, registry-installed, no fork). Versions for the storage stack pinned to what probes/hyperdrive-replicate-under-bare confirmed.
